title: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) / 肾综合征出血热

properties.disease overview: Hantavirus infection characterized by vascular endothelial injury leading to capillary leak, shock tendency, and renal involvement, typically progressing through febrile → shock → oliguric → polyuric → recovery phases.
properties.mechanism: Viremia → endothelial cell damage → vascular permeability↑ → plasma extravasation → hypovolemia/shock + renal injury.
properties.disorder: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) / 肾综合征出血热
